predictions: There are quite a few teams in the league with whom I have pick records like 3-3 or 3-4… and a couple with whom I'm 2-4 or even 2-5. And I don't really love any of those records, but they are what they are, and at times it's just hard to pick these matches. But NOTHING can explain how far I am from figuring out the Cheap Shots in F division. The Cheapies have won 3 matches and lost 4 matches so far… and I've picked them to win 4 times and to lose 3 times… aaaand… I've had it backwards every damn time! No joke, I'm 0-7 in Cheap Shots match picks. This is record-setting stuff, man. Oh, also, I'm 133-67 (66.5% correct) for the season thus far.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ One Time. This is two weeks in a row in the spotlight for One Time (I hope this one doesn't come out with the same penalty outcome!). There is probably only time for one time to really battle the Corks for the F crown, and One Time has scored 11+ every week this season. This week, they get a few more, 15-9.

Match #2: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ One Armed Bandits. Menace could be so good, but it's so hard to pick them when they are almost endlessly shorthanded. With only one team in D above 0.500, this one is just critical in determining a top-two spot - you just have to go with the team that will have six players, right? I do tonight… Bandits, 12-10.

Match #3: (C Div.) OnlyDarts @ Darty Little Secrets. I really don't know why the Secrets don't have a better record. But Bill Parcells was right… you are what your record says you are. So I'm just going to have to accept that one. The other thing I accept is that OnlyDarts is pretty damn good. Which makes picking OnlyDarts easier here, 14-10.

Match #4: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Buffalo Bulls. Darty is the only B team with only one loss. Buffalo just lost to a 2-win team. So why does this still feel like a toss-up? Because Buffalo is a sneaky good team, that's why. Alas, Darty is the class of this crowd, and it's them, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Nine Lives @ Breakfast Club. Area is so far ahead, the real race in D is a pretty amazing race between, well… everyone else. The Niners get a critical victory here, in a tiebreaker.

Match #6: (E Div.) D's Bad News Bears @ Ton 80 Proof. Every E team that isn't Point of Attack is fashioning one hell of a race for the #2 slot. Last time, Bad News won in a romp. Let's do a 180, 13-11.
Match #7: (H Div.) Flight Club @ Bright Side of Flights. The Club currently holds the #2 spot in H. With just a small run, that spot could be Bright Side's soon instead. Flight Club this time, 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Big Duck Energy. The five in the middle of C are nearly inseparable. Yet one of them is likely in B next season, while another is likely to be in D then. Sanchez, 13-11.
Match #9: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ Shark Shooters. Three F teams separated by a total of 5 points are only two wins out of second. And yet, one of them is likely going to fall to G. Shooters, 13-11.
Match #10: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Sofa Kings. The center of G is tight, so this one affects both the race for 2nd and the race to avoid a drop to H. We Throw It prevails, 14-10.
Match #11: (G Div.) Aim For Fame @ Red-eye Rangers. This G match, on the other hand, is only about teams trying to avoid that drop to H. I'm thinking Aim reprises their lone win so far, 14-10.
And the remaining 14 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: The Hunted Element 19, Why So Serious? 5; Jonesing for Mugs 19, Wing & a Plaque 5; Show Me 16, Dart Attack 8.
